chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman in ihram: she may wear all jewellery, except jewellery that is conspicuous for adornment.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةِ: a woman in the state of ihram
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, in a general sense

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in ihram wear jewellery?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what a woman in the state of ihram may wear. It permits wearing jewellery generally, while excluding jewellery that is openly prominent as adornment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2634 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a woman in Ihram:
"She may wear all types of jewellery, except for jewellery that is prominently worn for adornment."
